propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision findings regardless of type, but bugfix-size-attestation blocks can be remedied by earning a plan-review attestation on the ticket without code changes

recheck-review should accept a bugfix-size-attestation block if the bot's vote message header shows exactly one blocking finding, that finding is bugfix-size-attestation, and the ticket's plan-review attestation classifies as accepted

label copy conditions (NO_CODE_CHANGE, TRIVIAL_REBASE) propagate stale bugfix-size-attestation blocks across patchsets even after the attestation is earned, forcing unnecessary code changes to retrigger review
the retrigger eligibility decision must read only the bot's own vote message and ticket store state, never the requesting comment, to prevent spoofing the criterion id or ticket id
